items.title: Slide Hampton — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] So kind of the way it exists in the Basie band. You had a Hershel Evans. You had a Lester Young.

ctx.x: Just in improvisational things. Not in the ensemble, because in the ensemble we tried to play as much alike as possible.
So kind of the way it exists in the Basie band. You had a Hershel Evans. You had a Lester Young. You had those – that could be foils, in a sense, to each other.
Yes. The thing was that we in fact – Don was a smart enough man to know that the best thing for us to do in there was try to make our styles match.
